# Handoff — Vanta Eclipse

**Snapshot: 2026-08-05.** Point-in-time, hand-written, *not* regenerated by
`tools/make_docs.py`. Treat the numbers here as "was true when written" and
re-run the sweep to get current ones. Everything under "Conventions" and
"Traps" is durable; everything under "State" decays.

---

## What this is

A portrait, offline, idle RPG for Android. Godot 4.7, GDScript, ~69 `.gd`
files, 28 screens, 20 autoload managers, 93 `.tres` content definitions.
Pixel art on a closed 16-colour palette. No monetisation active.

Read [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) first — it is accurate and
enforced (stage 8 fails the sweep if it names a file that does not exist).

## NOT ready for Google Play — three blockers

1. **Privacy policy 404s.** `docs/privacy-policy.html` exists but **GitHub
   Pages is off**, so `https://kidriqrif.github.io/Vanta-Eclipse/privacy-policy.html`
   returns 404. That blocks the Play Console field *and* breaks the in-app
   Settings → Privacy button, which opens that exact URL
   (`scripts/ui/settings_menu.gd`, `PRIVACY_URL`). The page also still has a
   DRAFT banner and a literal `[CONTACT EMAIL]`.
   *Fix: Settings → Pages → main → `/docs`, then fill the two placeholders.*

2. **The Shop shows a development banner** — "Development build — purchases
   are simulated and nothing is charged" — to every user and reviewer.
   `MonetizationManager.USE_STUB_PROVIDERS = true` hides all paid surfaces,
   which is correct (there is no ad SDK and no Play Billing in the bundle),
   but the banner ships.

3. **Play Console forms not done**: Data Safety, IARC content rating, App
   access.

**Also verify before planning a launch date:** if the developer account is a
*personal* one created after Nov 2023, Play requires a closed test with 12
testers for 14 continuous days before production access. That is a two-week
gate, not a form.

`production/store-listing.md` has been corrected to declare **no ads and no
IAP**, matching what actually installs. Flip both back in the same change that
sets `USE_STUB_PROVIDERS = false`.

## Conventions that will bite you if you do not know them

**Every asset is generated.** Sprites, the bitmap font, icons and all audio
come from `tools/make_*.py`. Never hand-edit a PNG or WAV — stage 13
(`tools/check_generated.py`) re-runs every generator and demands byte-identity,
so a touched file fails the build. Change the program, re-run it.

**The palette is closed at 16 colours** (`tools/pixelart.py`). Stage 12
checks *every pixel of every shipped PNG*, not just source literals.

**Every font size is a multiple of 9.** `vanta_pixel` is a bitmap face whose
glyphs exist at 9px only; anything else makes Godot resample and go soft. Use
`tools/snap_font_sizes.py`. Legal tiers in use: 18 / 27 / 36 / 45 / 54.

**Surfaces are flat.** No corner radii, no soft shadows, no gradients — a
falloff is dithered (`ground_glow()`) or hard-stepped (`menu_divider()`).

**The README fact block and the GitHub Pages site are generated** by
`tools/make_docs.py` and refreshed automatically by the Stop hook on every
commit. Edit prose *outside* the `<!-- generated -->` markers freely; never
inside. Stage 14 fails on drift.

**⚠ The repo auto-commits and pushes to a PUBLIC GitHub remote every single
turn** (`~/.claude/auto-push.sh`, a Stop hook). Anything left in the working
tree ships. Never write a credential, keystore or API key into the repo. The
upload keystore lives *outside* it at `~/keystores/vanta-eclipse-upload.jks`;
`export_credentials.cfg` is gitignored.

**The signer fingerprint must never change.** Play binds the app to its first
upload key permanently:
`3A:5B:8A:01:C8:37:06:8B:CB:F1:06:B3:2A:45:3B:6C:8D:9E:EE:3A:9B:8D:9C:EA:EB:9C:DB:A0:AB:D2:62:13`
Verify with
`~/dev-tools/jdk-17/bin/keytool.exe -printcert -jarfile build/vanta-eclipse.aab`.

## Traps this project has actually hit

The recurring failure is **a check that reports something other than what it
verifies**. Found repeatedly; assume more exist.

- A sprite scan globbing `*.svg` after every sprite became a `*.png` — passed
  vacuously for an entire restyle.
- A glyph check naming a font replaced two restyles earlier.
- A voice-pool check using `>=` that passed while 7 of 14 sounds failed to load.
- A stage reporting `tail -1` (an engine warning) instead of its own verdict.
- **All four Arcade minigames shipped un-parseable** (`const X = SomeClass.f()`
  is not a constant expression). The whole Arcade was dead through a 14-stage
  sweep, 71 runtime checks and a screenshot pass. Now caught by
  `_check_scripts_parse` in `tools/logic_harness.gd`.

**Generated output must be looked at, not reasoned about.** Every sprite that
came out wrong looked correct in source. A screenshot harness reported four
empty screens as successes because it only measured overflow and font size.
Render it and open the image.

**Positive-control your controls.** When testing that a check catches a defect,
*assert the injection applied*. Three of my own positive controls silently did
nothing because the anchor string did not exist in the file.

## Tooling installed

- **graphify** (`/graphify`) — knowledge graph over the repo. **Covers
  `tools/`, `docs/`, `design/` only: 530 Markdown / 324 Python / 16 shell /
  0 GDScript.** No tree-sitter grammar for `.gd`, so for anything in
  `scripts/` or `scenes/` use Grep and Read. Its PreToolUse hooks were removed
  deliberately; see [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md). Rebuild with `graphify update .`
  (free, local, no LLM).
- **asset-gen** (`~/.claude/skills/asset-gen/`) — AI image/3D generation.
  **Not usable: no API keys set**, and `ffmpeg`/ImageMagick are missing. Its
  output can never ship here (stages 12 and 13 reject it); the legitimate use
  is generating a *reference* to hand-author a pixel sprite from.
  ⚠ On Windows `convert` resolves to `C:\WINDOWS\system32\convert.exe`, which
  converts a FAT volume to NTFS. Use `magick`.
